biography.plain_text: Juan Miguel Villar Mir was a Spanish engineer and industrialist who built Grupo Villar Mir around the rescue of the construction company Obrascón. Born in Madrid, he had managed major businesses before becoming an owner. His group expanded into metals, fertilisers and property, while he also taught business organisation at university.

Born in Madrid, he had managed major businesses before becoming an owner. His group expanded into metals, fertilisers and property, while he also taught business organisation at university.

confidence.reason: Primary academic and business histories support the claims; the management method is paraphrased without adopting promotional judgements.

long_biography.plain_text:
When Juan Miguel Villar Mir bought a business, he generally retained its management team while changing responsibilities, reporting structures and objectives. The engineer had spent two decades running companies for other owners before assembling his own group. His approach combined acquisitions of struggling businesses with investment in their existing operations and expansion into international markets.

Teaching remained a substantial part of his working life. At Madrid's civil-engineering school, he held a professorship in business organisation and founded master's programmes in construction-company management and infrastructure and public-service management. He also directed doctoral and postgraduate courses and wrote teaching texts, bringing company administration into the training of engineers.
